rationale: All functions stay on Supabase: generate-sitemap, generate-rss, and articles-feed have load-bearing public URLs referenced by robots.txt, feed readers, and AI crawlers; several run on cron (auto-publish-compass, payment-reminders) or are invoked via supabase.functions.invoke from pages that are currently dormant. Migrating any of them would change public URLs and scheduled behavior, which the user ruled out (minimal migration, no other changes).
